messages:
eli: Thinking out loud: add a tenant-level "auto_rollforward" toggle that lets us probe v1 when v2 is unavailable. Need to cover billing, quotas, telemetry, and console copy. Anyone object to a soft/strict mode?

rhea: No objections. Important Q: if a probe gets routed to v1, do we consume v1 quota and bill v1 price? We need deterministic behavior for billing reports.

samir: Yes — bill where the request executed. Also label those requests in billing exports with `served_model` and `probe=true` so customers and ops can reconcile.

neel: Perf caveat: sampling must preserve locality. Do cohort sampling keyed by tenant+session and keep stickiness for N minutes. Otherwise KV cache hit rate collapses.

eli: Proposed config snippet:

```
auto_rollforward:
  enabled: true
  mode: soft  # soft | strict
  probe_pct: 3
  sampling_key: hash(tenant_id || session_id)
  sticky_for: 10m
  audit_header: x-rwd-internal-probe
```

rhea: Console UX: show "Projected monthly cost change" before you flip. Run a simulate using last 30 days of token usage and model prices. If projection variance > X show a warning.

samir: Telemetry needs: counter `rollforward.probes_total{tenant,cohort}`, gauge `rollforward.active_cohorts`, histograms per-model latency. Also emit `quota_violation_attempts{tenant}` when a probe would exceed the target model's tenant quota.

neel: For safety: if probe would push tenant over reserved quota on fallback model, automatically demote to probe-only (no aggressive failover) and surface a blocking prompt in the UI. Also add a server-side soft-throttle to avoid bursts.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: sampling feature flag created in staging. Patch: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4389 - will canary tomorrow. :eyes:

eli: Security note: don't mirror the probe header to customer-facing services. Strip at the edge. Keep probe cohort ids in audit logs for debugging, but encrypt them at rest.

rhea: Trace sampling: allow per-tenant override `trace_pct`. Defaults: `trace_pct = min(1%, probe_pct)` to bound logging costs. Add UI toggle "Include spans for probes".

samir: Edge case: v1 uses stricter concurrency limits. Probes must check per-model-rate limits before routing; if limited, respond with internal fallback (queue/throttle) and increment `rollforward.throttled{tenant}`. Expose that in console.

eli: UX copy draft for the toggle:

"Enable automatic, measured roll-forward to an older model when your preferred model is congested. Soft mode: small sample of traffic probes the fallback without failing requests. Strict mode: fallback used when capacity is exhausted. We will show an estimated cost impact and any quota conflicts before you enable"

neel: Action items: UI mock (rhea), billing simulation + export labels (samir), sampling implementation + sticky hashing (neel), audit/docs + RFC (eli). I'll open the RFC after infra canary passes.

eli: Thanks all. Filing the RFC & linking PRs once canary is green. :thumbsup:
